start.resumePrompt: You have an unfinished game. Resume?

setup.title: Player Setup
setup.boardFixedHint: The board size is not configurable.
setup.expertiseHint: Pick up to 2 major categories. Tap a selected one to open its subcategories — up to 2 of those.
setup.introExpertise: Every player picks an expertise: up to 2 major categories (e.g. Science) and up to 2 subcategories (e.g. Physics). Your first question each round is drawn from those areas.
setup.introTrade: The narrower the claim, the dearer it is: a subcategory never yields an easy question — there, hard and very hard are the rule.
setup.settingsIntro: {count} players ready. These settings apply to the whole game.
setup.linesToWinOne: One full row, column or diagonal wins.
setup.linesToWinTwo: Two full lines needed. They may cross — a row plus a column counts as two.
setup.startingPegsNote: Pegs every player already has on the board at the start. More pegs means a shorter game.
setup.placementCandidatesNote: How many fields you may choose between when placing a peg. 1 means purely random.

question.mapInstruction: Tap the correct location on the map

board.title: {name}'s Board
board.tapToPlace: Tap a glowing field to place your peg

settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceNote: Off means questions and answers are never read aloud at all — not merely silenced.
settings.languageNote: Applies to the interface and to the language questions are drawn in. The current question is unaffected.
settings.creditsIcons: Joker icons: Font Awesome Free 6.7.2, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
settings.creditsFont: Typeface: Nunito, licensed under the SIL Open Font License.
settings.abandonNote: Ends the running game and returns to the main menu.
settings.abandonConfirmBody: The current game is lost — every player's pegs, jokers and progress. This cannot be undone.

gambler.title: All on one card
gambler.staking: You are staking your peg on {field}
gambler.terms: Right: three pegs, placed at random — you do not choose where. Wrong: the staked peg is gone. Either way your turn ends.

jokerDesc.reshuffle_selection: Discards the four offered questions and draws four new ones. This joker is spent afterwards.
jokerDesc.reshuffle_question: Replaces the current question with another from the same category. This joker is spent afterwards.
jokerDesc.reveal_hint: Shows a hint for the current question. This joker is spent afterwards.
jokerDesc.the_gambler: Stakes one of your pegs. Answer correctly and you gain three pegs; answer wrong and you lose the staked one.
jokerDesc.steal: Takes a random peg from another player's board.
jokerDesc.curse: The chosen player's next question becomes hard, whichever slot they pick.
jokerDesc.snipe: Removes one specific peg from an opponent's board.
jokerDesc.double_down: Your next correct answer awards two pegs instead of one.

battle.title: Battle
battle.rules: Everyone guesses. Closest wins — last place gives a peg to first, on the very same square. Nothing happens to anyone in between.
